description: Pectoralis minor hides beneath its larger sibling, tugging the scapula forward and carving the undercut beneath the clavicle.
actions: Protracts the scapula, drawing it anteriorly to round the shoulder during reach and push motions.
Depresses the scapula, helping anchor the shoulder girdle when the hands bear weight.
Assists with elevating the ribs during forced inspiration when the scapula is fixed.
